$comment: PERMANENT Android release identity for S4 (UAT-MOB-02, Gate 4A).
This file holds PUBLIC data only: the certificate SHA-256 fingerprint, the package id and the
expected release metadata. It contains no keystore, no alias, no password and no private key, and it
must never be made to hold any of them — the keystore itself stays outside the repository.
Gate 4A moved S4 to its permanent store identity, com.sfour.s4, starting at 1.1.0 / versionCode 13.
That is a NEW Android application: it cannot update, and is not updated by, the development-era
com.securitymarketplace.mobile builds, whose records are kept below under legacyPackage.
The signer is unchanged: the same permanent S4 certificate signed every historical S4 APK and signs
com.sfour.s4. Under Google Play App Signing (Gate 4B) it is the UPLOAD key, so this is the
certificate an uploaded AAB, or a locally signed APK, must carry. The certificate Google then signs
installed copies with is recorded here as playAppSigning.appSigningCertificateSha256 once the Play
app exists — it is not known before then and must not be guessed.
Why the pin exists at all: EAS Build 8 was signed with an EAS-generated keystore instead of this one,
and nothing in the release process could see it until a device refused the update.

signer.subject: CN=S4 Security, OU=S4 Pilot, O=Vesoft Services Limited, C=GB
signer.role: Permanent S4 key. Signs locally built artefacts and is the intended Google Play upload key for com.sfour.s4.

approvedArtefact.note: No 1.1.0 artefact exists yet. Gate 4B records the EAS build id, the git commit and the AAB SHA-256 here after verifying the upload signer.

playAppSigning.note: Filled in Gate 4B from the Play Console App integrity page after the Play app is created.

rejectedBuilds.reason: Signed with an EAS-generated keystore, not the permanent S4 identity. Cannot update an installed S4 build. Rejected for distribution; history retained.

legacyPackage.status: final development-package pilot build; retire once S4 1.1.0 is approved on Google Play Internal Testing

approvedArtefact.note: The replacement Build 12, containing fix(guard): target live shift for current-shift actions. Two artefacts carry versionCode 12; this build id and hash identify the one approved for UAT.

supersededBuilds.reason: Current-shift actions could validate a historical selectedShift instead of the authoritative live shift. Confirmed on a real device: the Current Shift card showed In Progress / LIVE with a Book On recorded, while Welfare Check, Log Book and Emergency all refused with "only available during an active shift" and emitted no request. Signed correctly with the permanent S4 identity; superseded for its content, not its signer.
supersededBuilds.supersededBy: the replacement Build 12 built from aaf6c5e or a descendant
